bathrooms.name: Bathrooms
bathrooms.description: Transform your bathroom into a beautiful, functional space. We handle everything from simple updates to complete bathroom renovations including tile work, fixtures, vanities, and more.

concrete.name: Concrete
concrete.description: Professional concrete services including driveways, patios, walkways, and foundations. We deliver durable, quality concrete work that stands the test of time.

decks.name: Decks
decks.description: Build the outdoor living space of your dreams. We construct beautiful, durable decks using quality materials that will last for years to come.

drainage-retaining-walls.name: Drainage & Retaining Walls
drainage-retaining-walls.description: Professional drainage solutions and expertly built retaining walls to protect your property. We install French drains, downspout extensions, and grading to manage water flow, plus build strong retaining walls with stone, block, and concrete to manage slopes and prevent erosion.

drywalling.name: Drywalling
drywalling.description: Professional drywall installation and repair services. We handle new construction, repairs, texturing, and finishing to give your walls a flawless look.

electrical-work.name: Electrical Work
electrical-work.description: Safe and reliable electrical services for your home. From outlet installations to lighting upgrades, we ensure your electrical work is done right.

fences.name: Fences

flooring.name: Flooring
flooring.description: Upgrade your floors with professional installation services. We work with hardwood, laminate, tile, vinyl, and more to transform any room.

gutter-cleaning.name: Gutter Cleaning
gutter-cleaning.description: Keep your gutters flowing properly with our cleaning and maintenance services. We also install gutter guards to reduce future maintenance needs.

hvac.name: HVAC
hvac.description: Professional heating, ventilation, and air conditioning services. We handle installations, repairs, and maintenance to keep your home comfortable year-round.

junk-removal.name: Junk Removal
junk-removal.description: Fast and efficient junk removal services. We haul away unwanted items, debris, and clutter from your home or property responsibly.

kitchens.name: Kitchens
kitchens.description: Create your dream kitchen with our remodeling services. From cabinet installation to countertops and backsplashes, we do it all.

landscaping.name: Landscaping
landscaping.description: Transform your outdoor space with professional landscaping. We offer design, planting, hardscaping, and ongoing maintenance services.

masonry.name: Masonry
masonry.description: Expert masonry services including brick, stone, and block work. We build and repair walls, chimneys, patios, and other masonry structures with precision craftsmanship.

painting.name: Painting
painting.description: Refresh your space with professional interior and exterior painting services. We deliver clean, precise work with quality paints that last.

plumbing.name: Plumbing

powerwashing.name: Powerwashing
powerwashing.description: Restore the look of your home, driveway, deck, and more with professional pressure washing services that remove years of grime and buildup.

remodeling.name: Remodeling
remodeling.description: Complete home remodeling services to transform any space. We handle projects of all sizes with attention to detail and quality craftsmanship.

roofing.name: Roofing
roofing.description: Protect your home with professional roofing services. We offer repairs, replacements, and maintenance to keep your roof in top condition.

sheds-gates.name: Sheds & Gates
sheds-gates.description: Custom shed construction and gate installation services. We build functional, attractive structures that enhance your property.

siding.name: Siding
siding.description: Professional siding installation and repair services. We work with vinyl, fiber cement, wood, and other siding materials to protect and beautify your home.

snow-removal.name: Snow Removal
snow-removal.description: Reliable snow removal services to keep your property safe and accessible during winter. We offer residential and commercial snow clearing.

tree-trimming.name: Tree Trimming / Tree Cutting
tree-trimming.description: Professional tree trimming and pruning services to keep your trees healthy, safe, and looking their best.

waterproofing.name: Waterproofing
waterproofing.description: Protect your home from water damage with basement and foundation waterproofing services. We keep your home dry and safe.

stairs.name: Stairs
stairs.description: Professional stair installation, repair, and refinishing services. We build and restore beautiful, safe staircases that enhance your home.
